verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a simulator, so it is by nature an isolated test environment. Users run robot and sensor scenarios in simulated worlds rather than on real systems. The docs describe a headless, server-only package aimed explicitly at CI environments, and example worlds that can be freely copied and modified. However, the evidence never frames this as separating test runs from production data or real deployments, and offers nothing agent-oriented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of sim-vs-production isolation, agent-oriented sandbox workflows, independent/hands-on corroboration.
